players.product: Siyuan (MLU) cloud AI chips and accelerator cards, AI servers and intelligent computing cluster systems for large-model training and inference

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (unaudited): operating revenue RMB 5,995,573,619.61, up 108.13% YoY from RMB 2,880,643,471.09; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,310,912,080.33, up 122.61%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,165,555,778.52, up 137.30%. The company attributes the growth to continued market expansion and helping AI applications land; management says AI compute demand climbed steadily in H1 2026 and it deepened cooperation with leading financial and internet companies.

H1 2026 revenue by product line: cloud product line (cloud AI chips and boards, AI servers, clusters) RMB 5,994,218,575.37; edge product line RMB 877,168.14. All revenue was domestic (China); direct sales RMB 5,993,157,690.40, distribution RMB 2,415,929.21. Company: its products achieved sustained, scaled commercial deployment in finance and internet, and it worked with customers to extend large-scale training to new scenarios.
quarterly_data.figure: Cloud product line RMB 5,994,218,575.37; edge product line RMB 877,168.14

quarterly_data.signal: Customer concentration: 95.08% of accounts receivable and contract assets came from the top five customers at June 30, 2026 (94.09% at December 31, 2025). Contract liabilities rose to RMB 187,590,707.97 from RMB 610,619.47 at end-2025 (+30,621.38%), which the company attributes mainly to more advance contract payments received.
quarterly_data.figure: Top-5 customers 95.08% of receivables; contract liabilities RMB 187,590,707.97 (+30,621.38%)

quarterly_data.signal: Supply build-up: inventory RMB 8,247,509,484.00 at June 30, 2026 (+66.83% vs end-2025; 45.32% of total assets), mainly more raw materials and materials in outsourced processing; prepayments RMB 2,913,927,071.43 (+291.37%), mainly prepaid purchases, with the two largest prepayment counterparties at 47.23% and 41.91% of the balance; notes payable RMB 3,085,487,067.78 (+779.25%) from more bank-acceptance bills used for purchases. The company says upstream semiconductor raw-material prices are rising overall and it will respond through strategic stockpiling and product iteration.

Supply-chain risk (company disclosure): Cambricon is fabless; its suppliers include IP licensors, server makers, wafer fabs and packaging/test houses. The company and some subsidiaries are on the US 'Entity List', which poses a risk to supply-chain stability; switching to new suppliers would add cost. The company also notes NVIDIA still holds an absolute advantage in AI chips globally.

R&D: H1 2026 R&D expense RMB 702,466,071.26 (+29.63%), 11.72% of revenue; 1,007 R&D staff (80.62% of employees). A new-generation intelligent processor microarchitecture and instruction set is under development, optimized for training and inference of NLP large models, video/image generation models and vertical models. Software: continued adaptation of DeepSeek, Qwen, Hunyuan, GLM, Kimi and MiniMax models, Day-0 adaptation of DeepSeek and other domestic open-source models, low-precision training support and prefill-decode disaggregated inference.

Cambricon.why: Chinese AI accelerator designer; its cloud AI chips and boards (Siyuan/MLU) for large-model training and inference are its revenue base (cloud product line RMB 5,994,218,575.37 of RMB 5,995,573,619.61 H1 2026 revenue), so its stock tracks AI training/inference accelerator demand.
Cambricon.evidence: Cambricon 2026 half-year report: main business is R&D, design and sale of AI core chips for cloud servers, edge devices and terminals; cloud product line (cloud AI chips and boards, AI servers) revenue RMB 5,994,218,575.37 in H1 2026.
